name: Matilda Lutz
bio: Matilda Anna Ingrid Lutz was born on January 28, 1992 in Milan, Italy, to her parents Elliston Lutz and Maria Licci. She is an Italian model and actress. Lutz has an older brother Martin Perry Lutz and a younger half-brother Alexey Lutz. Lutz is known for her starring roles in Rings (2017) and Revenge (2017).
